country_event = {
	id = faction_alignment.1
	title = faction_alignment.1.t
	desc = faction_alignment.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_sign_treaty2
	trigger = {
		is_subject = no
		NOT = {
			is_in_faction = yes
		}
		NOT = {
			has_war = yes
		}
		any_neighbor_country = {
			NOT = {
				has_government = ROOT
			}
			OR = {
				has_war_support > 0.50
				has_idea = war_economy
				has_idea = partial_economic_mobilisation
			}
			NOT = {
				is_in_faction_with = ROOT
			}
			strength_ratio = {
				tag = ROOT
				ratio > 1.20
			}
		}
		any_other_country = {
			is_faction_leader = yes
			has_government = ROOT
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 120
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.70
			any_neighbor_country = {
				has_wargoal_against = ROOT
			}
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.50
			any_neighbor_country = {
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.80
			has_defensive_war = yes
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 4
			threat < 0.25
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.50
			threat > 0.50
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.50
			threat > 0.75
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		random_other_country = {
			limit = {
				is_faction_leader = yes
				has_government = ROOT
				NOT = {
					has_war_with = ROOT
				}
			}
			save_event_target_as = chosen_faction_leader_1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = faction_alignment.1.a
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 80
			modifier = {
				factor = 1.50
				any_neighbor_country = {
					has_wargoal_against = ROOT
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 2
				has_defensive_war = yes
			}
		}
		event_target:chosen_faction_leader_1 = {
			country_event = { id = faction_alignment.2 days = 1 }
		}
		add_political_power = -50
	}
	option = {
		name = faction_alignment.1.b
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 20
		}
		add_stability = 0.03
		add_war_support = 0.05
	}
}
